component {

    function run() {
        var x = [1, 2, 3, 4];
        var s = {a: 1, b: 2, d: 3, e: 4, g: 5};
        var st = {p: 1, q: {r: 2}, u: 3};
        var pairs = [[1, 2], [3, 4]];
        var structs = [{a: 1, b: 2}];
        [a, b] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, , c] = x;
        writeOutput(a & c);
        [, a] = x;
        writeOutput(a);
        [a, ,] = x;
        writeOutput(a);
        [a, b] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, ...r] = x;
        writeOutput(a & arrayLen(r));
        [a, [b, c], {d}] = [1, [2, 3], {d: 4}];
        writeOutput(a & b & c & d);
        [a, b = 9] = [1];
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, b] = [b, a];
        writeOutput(a & b);
        ({a, b: c, d = 1, e: f = 2, ...r} = s);
        writeOutput(a & c & d & f & structCount(r));
        ({a, b} = s);
        writeOutput(a & b);
        ({
            p: {
                q,
                r: [s1, s2]
            }
        } = {p: {q: 1, r: [2, 3]}});
        writeOutput(q & s1 & s2);
        one = 1;
        three = 3;
        var [va, , vc] = x;
        four = 4;
        var {
            p,
            q: {r: qr, w = 1},
            ...t
        } = st;
        two = 2;
        writeOutput(one & two & three & four & va & vc & p & qr & w & structCount(t));
        final [fa, fb] = x;
        writeOutput(fa & fb);
        for ([k, v] in pairs) {
            writeOutput(k & v);
        }
        for ({a, b} in structs) {
            writeOutput(a & b);
        }
        for (var [lk, lv] in pairs) {
            writeOutput(lk & lv);
        }
        for (var {a: la, b: lb} in structs) {
            writeOutput(la & lb);
        }
        ({
            a, // first
            b: c /* renamed */,
            d = 1
        } = s);
        writeOutput(a & c & d);
        h = function({a, b}) {
            return a + b;
        };
        k = ({a, b}) => a + b;
        m = ({a, b = 2}) => {
            return a + b;
        };
        writeOutput(h({a: 1, b: 2}) & k({a: 1, b: 2}) & m({a: 1}));
        writeOutput(sole({a: 1}) & mixed(1, {a: 2, p: {q: 3}}, {c: 4}) & nested({a: 1, p: {q: 2}}));
    }

    function sole({a, b = 2}) {
        return a + b;
    }

    function mixed(x, {a, b = 9, p: {q}, ...r}, {c}) {
        return x + a + b + q + c + structCount(r);
    }

    function nested({a, p: {q}}) {
        return a + q;
    }

}
~
component {

    function run() {
        var x       = [1, 2, 3, 4];
        var s       = {a: 1, b: 2, d: 3, e: 4, g: 5};
        var st      = {p: 1, q: {r: 2}, u: 3};
        var pairs   = [[1, 2], [3, 4]];
        var structs = [{a: 1, b: 2}];
        [a, b] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, , c] = x;
        writeOutput(a & c);
        [, a] = x;
        writeOutput(a);
        [a, ,] = x;
        writeOutput(a);
        [a, b] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, ...r] = x;
        writeOutput(a & arrayLen(r));
        [a, [b, c], {d}] = [1, [2, 3], {d: 4}];
        writeOutput(a & b & c & d);
        [a, b = 9] = [1];
        writeOutput(a & b);
        [a, b] = [b, a];
        writeOutput(a & b);
        ({a, b: c, d = 1, e: f = 2, ...r} = s);
        writeOutput(a & c & d & f & structCount(r));
        ({a, b} = s);
        writeOutput(a & b);
        ({
            p: {
                q,
                r: [s1, s2]
            }
        } = {p: {q: 1, r: [2, 3]}});
        writeOutput(q & s1 & s2);
        one   = 1;
        three = 3;
        var [va, , vc] = x;
        four = 4;
        var {
            p,
            q: {r: qr, w = 1},
            ...t
        } = st;
        two = 2;
        writeOutput(one & two & three & four & va & vc & p & qr & w & structCount(t));
        final [fa, fb] = x;
        writeOutput(fa & fb);
        for ([k, v] in pairs) {
            writeOutput(k & v);
        }
        for ({a, b} in structs) {
            writeOutput(a & b);
        }
        for (var [lk, lv] in pairs) {
            writeOutput(lk & lv);
        }
        for (var {a: la, b: lb} in structs) {
            writeOutput(la & lb);
        }
        ({
            a, // first
            b: c /* renamed */,
            d = 1
        } = s);
        writeOutput(a & c & d);
        h = function({a, b}) {
            return a + b;
        };
        k = ({a, b}) => a + b;
        m = ({a, b = 2}) => {
            return a + b;
        };
        writeOutput(h({a: 1, b: 2}) & k({a: 1, b: 2}) & m({a: 1}));
        writeOutput(sole({a: 1}) & mixed(1, {a: 2, p: {q: 3}}, {c: 4}) & nested({a: 1, p: {q: 2}}));
    }

    function sole({a, b = 2}) {
        return a + b;
    }

    function mixed(x, {a, b = 9, p: {q}, ...r}, {c}) {
        return x + a + b + q + c + structCount(r);
    }

    function nested({a, p: {q}}) {
        return a + q;
    }

}
